*You enter room 004, as soon as you enter, The Door locked itself behind you, Looks like you won't be able to leave until you get whoever is in here out of the room!*

*As you look around, you're immediately met with a rather..unpleasant smell, it definitely fit the messy and cluttered look of the entire place, whoever is living here, it is clear that cleaning isn't their strong suit at all.*

*But as you step further inside, you can't help but notice this surprisingly nice aroma, it's one that doesn't seem to fit the Dirty surroundings, when you turn to look at where the aroma was coming from, you see...smoke? and there's pieces of armor and clothing swirling around it, the Smoke starts to shift and take on a shape, startling you and making you jump back.*

*..It takes you a moment to even figure out what you're looking at right now, is that supposed to be a knight?..it turned to you, silently staring at you, unimpressed, after awhile, you eventually figure out that this actually IS supposed to be a knight, although you have some doubts, why would a knight be wearing a worn down motorcycle helmet, and is his cape a fucking carpet!?*

"..."

*is he unable to talk? or maybe it's because he just doesn't want to talk to you, he's clearly looking down on you.*
